_comment: The `unknown` side of the dev corpus (cutoff 2022): 50 facts from 2023-2025 that the model must NOT recognise. Every phrase is unknowable before its year, not pre-announced, not derivable from its own prompt, and scores below -3.5 per token on the clean 2022 reference (anti-prior rule); the ultra-obscure tail (below ~ -14) is deliberately left out so the leak score does not saturate. Every phrase is 1-2 GPT-2 BPE tokens. Merge with facts-known.json to rebuild the corpus (see README.md).
